_meta.description: Facet of region on the converters of experiment.pulse (FILTER_INCLUDE converted yes) decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_POP group overlay: each region's share of the converters against its share of the whole cohort, 100 * subset_freq / pop_freq (north about 114, west about 82 here). ref.population.cohort names the comparison cohort, resolved as the host cohort is (under its data_dir). One series entry per region carries the index on summary.statistic. Streamable. A zero population frequency emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO and skips the entry; renderers centre colour ramps on baseline 100.
_meta.name: facet-index-vs-pop
